prompt: A pre-game player-introduction shot on a live basketball broadcast. The man from the character sheet, with the face and short trimmed beard of the two headshots, stands alone in a hard white spotlight in the dark hazy arena. He slowly rotates on the spot toward the camera, his shoulders turning from facing away to a three-quarter angle, his head and eyes staying locked on the lens, calm, serious and confident. At the same time the camera slowly orbits around him to the left and pushes in, so the dark crowd and the LED ribbon boards slide past behind him with strong parallax. Haze drifts through the spotlight beam, small crowd lights twinkle. Photoreal broadcast footage, one continuous shot, no cuts, no text.
